The D1V population spans exactly one anchor (CAL-POS-2) on BOTH retained corpora (M-N-D1V=6, M-N-D1V-ANCHORS=1); the other anchors are value-bearing but D1V-blocked with byte-level transport causes (CAL-POS-1=BODY_DERIVED_ETAG, CAL-POS-3=TOKEN_BEARING_FINAL_URL, CAL-POS-4=NO_FIELD); the transport-value coupling is time-stable (M-TRANSPORT-COUPLING-STABILITY=UNCHANGED on all four anchors at both dates). Decisively, even if the anchor count were raised to >= 2 (e.g. via remedy b), the mandated object remains unreachable because on every value-only-rotation trial the value-blind incumbent B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY is at the false-accept ceiling (REUSE, since neither CH-STRUCT-SIG nor CH-TRANSPORT-VALIDATOR nor CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires) while the value-aware comparator B-VALUE-AWARE is at the floor (ABSTAIN, because D1V requires STALE, i.e. live != recorded). The per-trial paired differential is therefore identically 1 for any pure D1V trial, so the anchor-clustered paired interval is the zero-width [1,1] for ANY number of anchors. A non-degenerate read would require WITHIN-anchor variation of the incumbent decision, i.e. CH-POSTCOND-SEM in-list field-name-set drift co-occurring with D1V; that is (i) absent on the accepted repertoire (M-N-POSTCOND-DRIFT=0 on both corpora), (ii) not value-only rotation (it is a second, independent channel), and (iii) not pre-certifiable for a new anchor population without outcome-bearing anchor screening (prohibited at DESIGN). Any value rotation that changes the body forces CH-TRANSPORT-VALIDATOR to fire, so the value-only-rotation family cannot form: transport_change is forced for every value-changing request pair.

This is the only anchor contributing D1V trials (M-N-D1V=6).

The transport component is a DIFFERENT credential-bearing token than the in-list rotated value, so transport_change is forced by a transport field that is not the rotating value; route-b reclassification (motion caused solely by the rotating value) is structurally unsound here.

degeneracy_argument.claim: The mandated object (non-degenerate anchor-clustered 97.5% lower bound of M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V on a >= 2-anchor D1V population) is ARITHMETICALLY UNREACHABLE on this substrate even if M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2 were achieved.
degeneracy_argument.proof_sketch: Frozen D1V is STALE (live value != recorded value) AND NOT structural_change AND NOT transport_change. On a D1V trial, B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY REUSEs unless CH-STRUCT-SIG, CH-TRANSPORT-VALIDATOR or CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires; the first two are false by the D1V definition and the third is false on the accepted repertoire (M-N-POSTCOND-DRIFT=0 on both corpora), so incumbent REUSE = 1. B-VALUE-AWARE REUSEs only if live == recorded, which D1V forbids (STALE), so value-aware REUSE = 0 and value-aware false-accept = 0. Hence the per-trial paired differential is identically 1 on every D1V trial, and the anchor-clustered bootstrap of a constant 1 over any number of anchors returns the zero-width [1,1]. Non-degeneracy would require within-anchor variation of the incumbent decision, i.e. CH-POSTCOND-SEM field-name-set drift co-occurring with D1V; that is absent (M-N-POSTCOND-DRIFT=0), is a second independent channel rather than value-only rotation, and cannot be pre-certified for a new anchor population without prohibited outcome-bearing screening.
degeneracy_argument.consequence: PC-ESTIMATOR-POWER-DEMO (LOW=2/3, UB97=1.0) is powered ONLY because its synthetic pseudo-anchor B deliberately injects postcond drift, i.e. within-anchor incumbent ABSTAINs; that variation does not exist in the real D1V family. The estimator is powered; the OBJECT is not constructible.

estimator_arithmetic.conclusion: the estimator is powered; the blocker is population/object constructibility, and specifically the absence of within-D1V incumbent variation on the accepted repertoire.

route_b_rejection.question: could an instrument redesign reclassify transport-validator motion (caused by value rotation) so that a second anchor enters D1V (mandate remedy b)?
route_b_rejection.finding: REJECTED at byte level on the accepted repertoire; no structural, non-circular reclassification exists for the blocked anchors:
route_b_rejection.CAL-POS-1: the ETag is exactly sha256(body)[:32] wrapped in W/"..."; it changes because the body changes, and the body changes are NOT solely the in-list value (per-request nonces, per-session authenticity_tokens, many differing regions). Reclassifying this motion as value-caused would mean dropping CH-TRANSPORT-VALIDATOR for motion not caused by the rotating value - circular and false at byte level.
route_b_rejection.CAL-POS-3: the final_url token (32-hex centralauthLoginToken) differs from the rotating in-list wpLoginToken values; the transport component is a different token with an independent cause; no principled rule maps final_url motion to the in-list value's motion.
route_b_rejection.CAL-POS-4: no fields at all; no reclassification can create trials.
route_b_rejection.consequence: remedy (b) is not constructible on this repertoire; remedy (a) (a materially different anchor population with transport validators independent of the rotating value) would require new anchor-pool screening outside the accepted CC-A bound and is UNKNOWN rather than certified - and even if it produced a second anchor, the degeneracy_argument shows the required non-degenerate bound would still not exist. This is precisely why the certificate is bounded to the accepted repertoire and why the broader-population question is handed to the Director.
